Blowfish can temporarily relieve **headaches and fatigue** from a hangover, though it does not cure a hangover or undo alcohol's effects on the body. Its active ingredients are **aspirin** (pain relief) and **caffeine** (alertness) in a fizzy tablet dissolved in water.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF11B-0NlXBmXQZ00xtqN1VgpYHnxwtzirpLz78YYsmP2o3yA6JfFTOuZkdkqaIaTS0ec6WSebC_lrgEh-iY35R0c7Z26NoxpLWkkD1vmgll6D4nEl6HVoJ2lbdhMrgw6d_7FdGYzEnG8YTM1_pvdgDoLOnFatiwVivyJzgsR1mZPJieix8TJAQnhpJytYN4jNKyLj)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXLoeWqJKQEq8DS_H7fIiui2VjqIgUL76TqdsG-pRBUNbdxcJUNP-W8WvBAcVeQLtC_i_Koed7CDH4BciUqwpQQ3_oFgPrze-CxVQk93YPlShWCma6v0LKanPOM0BGc-iv)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXEYy1vhI6tMo4mj0mj2aOV628NgOjs7Rnlo6oz1bC9pSu2BCR_xKjbwqnIQhRAqbWqsWb90Is2DiFytqftEqJgpXcma6NbJ3KPC-1ANHn4XwbXW-95me3M5qpAMcTq8HoNEkyEWOspgFgyfimWCpqlfsD)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXXuJxTf-S0EtPCE-puVxF7BjHn2LHH8GPHAn7OsO9nc41hT-fvINjcgI-A8ZpmNy3pGbGUOEjAXRMhQQ3kHCXm3Oh-VGp4uWJuw9k-06i9JUwigD5-92Y8Bpp1o9d_9ChbxE-_hEWyQ)

### What It Helps—and What It Doesn't

- **Relieves pain and grogginess:** Aspirin targets headache pain, while caffeine helps fight fatigue. Because the tablet dissolves in water, it can absorb quickly and provide fluids at the same time.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXLoeWqJKQEq8DS_H7fIiui2VjqIgUL76TqdsG-pRBUNbdxcJUNP-W8WvBAcVeQLtC_i_Koed7CDH4BciUqwpQQ3_oFgPrze-CxVQk93YPlShWCma6v0LKanPOM0BGc-iv)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXEYy1vhI6tMo4mj0mj2aOV628NgOjs7Rnlo6oz1bC9pSu2BCR_xKjbwqnIQhRAqbWqsWb90Is2DiFytqftEqJgpXcma6NbJ3KPC-1ANHn4XwbXW-95me3M5qpAMcTq8HoNEkyEWOspgFgyfimWCpqlfsD)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF11B-0NlXBmXQZ00xtqN1VgpYHnxwtzirpLz78YYsmP2o3yA6JfFTOuZkdkqaIaTS0ec6WSebC_lrgEh-iY35R0c7Z26NoxpLWkkD1vmgll6D4nEl6HVoJ2lbdhMrgw6d_7FdGYzEnG8YTM1_pvdgDoLOnFatiwVivyJzgsR1mZPJieix8TJAQnhpJytYN4jNKyLj)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF1wUbw4qOUyr1vl7uGKZdm2rWKusfPoIAP1pEFpEPu2wQ8xS2_2v5CRgsAR-9FiKTwn2HPFZ8n_srfrmse3GDipvfnOJjc7QMIt3nCCf_bA_lm2qJM7GGThDwEw1m2n5bCkdPfIuNL0lDqyPJYWZDMz_NF97JWobkqSdriANK4j-biVvJGAgmbhZ4--7hKh5hwT4)
- **Doesn't cure the root causes:** A hangover involves dehydration, inflammation, sleep disruption, and alcohol metabolism—none of which are cured by aspirin and caffeine alone. As [BBC News](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXLoeWqJKQEq8DS_H7fIiui2VjqIgUL76TqdsG-pRBUNbdxcJUNP-W8WvBAcVeQLtC_i_Koed7CDH4BciUqwpQQ3_oFgPrze-CxVQk93YPlShWCma6v0LKanPOM0BGc-iv) notes, medical experts point out that masking symptoms does not fix the underlying effects of drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXDM2SIuOedXFp180s8UEiaA2L51dAsuIuwTkzhlgTM0LqDpJhAMp6a3Cx4yF5uanNEy63H1KQRg9HSkpQaHkoGM7yUlQ3ePf-DVrJ700J68WjF_09QOulZ-bfr6uARoQL3A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXLoeWqJKQEq8DS_H7fIiui2VjqIgUL76TqdsG-pRBUNbdxcJUNP-W8WvBAcVeQLtC_i_Koed7CDH4BciUqwpQQ3_oFgPrze-CxVQk93YPlShWCma6v0LKanPOM0BGc-iv)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXEYy1vhI6tMo4mj0mj2aOV628NgOjs7Rnlo6oz1bC9pSu2BCR_xKjbwqnIQhRAqbWqsWb90Is2DiFytqftEqJgpXcma6NbJ3KPC-1ANHn4XwbXW-95me3M5qpAMcTq8HoNEkyEWOspgFgyfimWCpqlfsD)
- **Similar to standard over-the-counter options:** The active formula is essentially aspirin plus caffeine, similar to standard pain/caffeine combinations, just packaged as a flavored effervescent drink.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF14Uq79IaLfqoRsVIqbm79cLvMfsbh7HYnSAIYClw5rSWE6CxIJSbA_yn_bURBF3MHxuy3XLpw5j-4VsDsFayASLX2UXAwOlbIIfXsnwFBxdP0g3FEyKKH6CCbNz5Ej95e6bqnlcn-nwX1zFrgazSYoSSg_g0M9TB8u65fqIg4cXKQ9NQJbFN)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXLoeWqJKQEq8DS_H7fIiui2VjqIgUL76TqdsG-pRBUNbdxcJUNP-W8WvBAcVeQLtC_i_Koed7CDH4BciUqwpQQ3_oFgPrze-CxVQk93YPlShWCma6v0LKanPOM0BGc-iv)

### Risks to Keep in Mind

- **Stomach irritation and bleeding:** Alcohol already irritates the stomach lining, and aspirin can increase the risk of stomach upset or gastrointestinal bleeding.
- **Caffeine side effects:** Combining it with coffee, tea, or energy drinks can cause jitteriness, a racing heart, or anxiety.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXWD4QtOZE_3K95LHhT4Q-78naOho97pWxiWBXN7p8LX2CXqqOnbqJzTbG0K4t7WABO0GdNp129YsqPxSDWz2uYjccwjNdsS9HD5zd56hVhtsOARd47A5G33OS1YrcT1I3aVYtHaatOFbByLEn0CLu-DEgORaJfBbl)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1_6il8FVrLGqDsaW0e98kGhKcEDiZOR6zcnovBRJqNkRrGYAjL7otfhpbfCiqBIFVxCQRkkn2EgEXsykJs017OMuRIEoXpu6MtB2fvSmckVWy1-_Wl1cyzNZ1e466dKO03lfdEoDml7uGIy01qfOt34EbGdPdoZ2syaxUcZ00F1J6ESNLQRfZW9o_EdYCHfmbw)

There is a consensus on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1_6il8FVrLGqDsaW0e98kGhKcEDiZOR6zcnovBRJqNkRrGYAjL7otfhpbfCiqBIFVxCQRkkn2EgEXsykJs017OMuRIEoXpu6MtB2fvSmckVWy1-_Wl1cyzNZ1e466dKO03lfdEoDml7uGIy01qfOt34EbGdPdoZ2syaxUcZ00F1J6ESNLQRfZW9o_EdYCHfmbw) that Blowfish is just caffeine and aspirin, and users note that aspirin should be avoided after drinking due to potential negative interactions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1_6il8FVrLGqDsaW0e98kGhKcEDiZOR6zcnovBRJqNkRrGYAjL7otfhpbfCiqBIFVxCQRkkn2EgEXsykJs017OMuRIEoXpu6MtB2fvSmckVWy1-_Wl1cyzNZ1e466dKO03lfdEoDml7uGIy01qfOt34EbGdPdoZ2syaxUcZ00F1J6ESNLQRfZW9o_EdYCHfmbw)Are you asking for **yourself** or **someone else** , and are you looking for **safer symptom relief** or **how to prevent hangovers** next time?
